announcement:
New here, or still have questions? **Chance 101** is up: 13 short episodes on how CHANCE.fun works, each with a one-question quiz. Find it in the Chance 101 topic and start from the pinned post.
18+ · Only where permitted

episodes.title: What is Chance?
episodes.caption:
**Episode 1 of 13: What is Chance?**

Someone puts up a prize. You decide if it's worth taking.

Creators fund the prize and set the entry price and odds. You see all of it before you pay, and every entry, result and payout is public on Robinhood Chain.

Next: Getting set up
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: Who funds the prize on a Chance?
quiz.explanation: Creators fund the prize before anyone can enter, and you see the prize, odds and entry price before you pay.

episodes.title: Getting set up
episodes.caption:
**Episode 2 of 13: Getting set up**

No crypto experience needed. Sign in with email, Google, X or Discord and a wallet is made for you, or connect your own.

Before your first entry, have the Chance's token and a little ETH ready, both on Robinhood Chain.

Next: Reading a Chance
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: Besides the Chance's token, what does your wallet need before your first entry?
options: A little ETH on Robinhood Chain
quiz.explanation: A little ETH pays for gas and the randomness fee. Free entries need it too.

episodes.title: Reading a Chance
episodes.caption:
**Episode 3 of 13: Reading a Chance**

Every number on a card, before you pay: your odds, the RTP, entries so far and the prize multiple.

Price, odds, duration and tiers are locked at launch. Not even Chance can change them.

Next: Taking an Instant Win
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: A Chance shows 60% RTP. What does that mean?
options: It's built to pay back 60% of entry spend over many entries
quiz.explanation: RTP is an average over many entries, not a promise. Any single entry can still lose everything you paid.

episodes.title: Taking an Instant Win
episodes.caption:
**Episode 4 of 13: Taking an Instant Win**

Pick your numbers, confirm in your wallet, and the result usually lands within seconds.

Match the winning number and the whole prize is yours. Any number has the same odds, birthday included.

Next: Taking a MultiWin
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: On an Instant Win, someone wins before your purchase lands. What happens to your entry?
quiz.explanation: Your entry price comes back in full. Gas and the randomness fee were already spent, so they don't.

episodes.title: Taking a MultiWin
episodes.caption:
**Episode 5 of 13: Taking a MultiWin**

Four digits, four tiers. The more digits match in the right spot, the bigger the tier.

Each entry is scored on its own, so one purchase can hold several winners. And the top tier says up to for a reason.

Next: What an entry costs
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: MultiWin. The winning number is 1789 and your entry is 9781. Which tier did you hit?
options: Tier 4, it has all four digits
No tier, the order is wrong
Tier 2, the 7 and 8 are in their spots
quiz.explanation: Only digits in the same spot count. The 7 and 8 match their spots, the 9 and 1 don't, so it's Tier 2.

episodes.title: What an entry costs
episodes.caption:
**Episode 6 of 13: What an entry costs**

Three costs: the entry price, gas and the randomness fee. You see all three before you confirm.

The 5% platform fee comes out of the entry price, not on top of it.

Next: How the winner is picked
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: Where does the 5% platform fee come from?
options: It's added on top of the entry price
It comes out of the entry price
It comes out of the prize
quiz.explanation: It's not added on top. On a 40 USDG entry, 38 goes to the creator and 2 to Chance, taken only when the entry settles.

episodes.title: How the winner is picked
episodes.caption:
**Episode 7 of 13: How the winner is picked**

Chance can't pick the winning number. It comes from a Chance-operated, commitment-verifiable provider, and every step is on the record.

Every entry has a Verify link, so you can check any result yourself.

Next: Getting paid
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: Can Chance pick the winning number?
options: No, and you can check any result yourself
quiz.explanation: The number comes from a Chance-operated, commitment-verifiable provider. Every entry's Verify link recomputes it from public receipts.

episodes.title: Getting paid
episodes.caption:
**Episode 8 of 13: Getting paid**

Winnings arrive by themselves. Nothing to claim, nobody approves it, and payouts only go to the wallet that entered.

Stuck? Both fixes are on the Player tab of your Dashboard.

Next: Creating a Chance
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: You won. How does the payout reach you?
options: It's sent to your wallet automatically
You message the team to claim it
quiz.explanation: It's paid in the same transaction that decides the result. Nobody approves it, and Chance never DMs first.

episodes.title: Creating a Chance
episodes.caption:
**Episode 9 of 13: Creating a Chance**

Your prize, your rules. Pick Instant Win or MultiWin, fund the prize, set the price and odds, and run it for 1 minute to 30 days.

Your risk has a ceiling: the prize you fund plus the 1% deposit fee.

Next: Sharing and referrals
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: As a creator, what's the most you can lose on a Chance?
options: No limit, if lots of people win
The prize you fund plus the 1% deposit fee
quiz.explanation: Your risk has a ceiling. Prize left at the end? Withdraw returns it, and with no entries the whole prize comes back.

episodes.title: Sharing and referrals
episodes.caption:
**Episode 10 of 13: Sharing and referrals**

Some Chances pay you to share. Look for Ref. on a card.

Your friends pay the same price. Your cut comes out of the creator's share and lands in your wallet when each entry settles.

Next: Points and Chance Games
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: A friend enters through your referral link. What do they pay?
options: The same price as everyone else
quiz.explanation: Link or not, the price is the same. Your cut comes out of the creator's share and is paid when the entry settles.

episodes.title: Points and Chance Games
episodes.caption:
**Episode 11 of 13: Points and Chance Games**

Points are your score. Earn them by playing, creating and finishing quests, then spend them on Chance Games.

They have no cash value and never convert into CHANCE.

Next: The CHANCE token
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: What can you spend Points on?
quiz.explanation: Chance Games usually cost 20 Points per entry. Points have no cash value and never convert into CHANCE.

episodes.title: The CHANCE token
episodes.caption:
**Episode 12 of 13: The CHANCE token**

CHANCE launched on September 30 as a fair launch on PONS, Robinhood Chain's token launchpad. 1 billion, fixed.

The real contract:
`0x500D15e7c0d0e99ac4Aae2A40D8738ba1b3167c9`
Search by the address, never the name. It gives no ownership, voting or revenue rights, and its price is never guaranteed.

Next: Staying safe
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: What's the safest way to find the real CHANCE token?
options: Use a claim link someone sent you
quiz.explanation: Anyone can launch a copy called CHANCE. The real contract is 0x500D15e7c0d0e99ac4Aae2A40D8738ba1b3167c9.

episodes.title: Staying safe
episodes.caption:
**Episode 13 of 13: Staying safe**

Prizes sit in contracts, not with us, and your wallet stays yours.

Never share your seed phrase. Anyone who asks for it is a scammer, and Chance never DMs first. Need a break? Email support@ravenshorernd.com to block your account for 24 hours, or for good.

Questions? Ask in General.

That's Chance 101. New here? Start from the pinned post.
18+ · Only where permitted

quiz.question: Someone says they're from the Chance team and DMs you first to help. What do you do?
options: Share your seed phrase so they can fix it
Ignore them. Chance never DMs first
quiz.explanation: Anyone who asks for your seed phrase is a scammer. For help, ask in the group or on Discord, or email support@ravenshorernd.com.
